scope_statement: Within user-managed Codex customization, Factory OS owns orchestration, model routing, factory selection, delegation policy, cost posture, and integration policy. Platform/admin/security constraints remain outside and above this user customization layer.

resource_roles.AGENTS.md: persistent guidance and local repository constraints
resource_roles.Custom Agents: bounded specialist roles with explicit model/sandbox settings

mutation_policy.phase_05: No deletion, disablement, rename, or rewrite. Inventory and plan only.
mutation_policy.future: Any cleanup mutation must be backup-first, reversible, and attributable to a reviewed plan.
